interface.name: mx_accelerators_v1

description.summary: grab key combinations for the shell

interface.description: This interface lets a privileged shell client grab accelerators: key combinations whose presses go to the client instead of the focused surface. While a grabbed key is held, the compositor repeats the pressed event; the released event ends it.

entry.name: invalid_accelerator
entry.summary: not a known key, or an unknown modifier

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object, releasing every accelerator it grabbed.

request.name: grab
request.description: Grab an accelerator. The answer is a grabbed event with its action id, or a grab_failed event.

arg.name: accelerator
arg.summary: modifiers in angle brackets, then an XKB keysym name: <Super><Shift>a, XF86AudioRaiseVolume

request.name: ungrab
request.description: Release a grab. An action id that is not one of this object's grabs is ignored.

arg.name: action_id
arg.summary: the id from the grabbed event

description.summary: an accelerator could not be grabbed

event.name: pressed
event.description: Sent on a press, and again for each repeat while the key is held.

event.name: released
event.description: Sent when the held key is released, or another grabbed key is pressed before it is.
